_comment: Obligation categories the symbolic arithmetic oracle must cover.
The oracle asks an SMT solver to confirm or refute what the buffer-overrun interval
domain and the Pulse formula engine concluded: that a join over-approximates both
arguments, that widening is inclusive, that pruning is both sound and deflationary,
and that a formula the engine calls unsatisfiable really is.
This list is a COVERAGE pin, not a count. A run must emit exactly these keys: a
category that stops being generated is a silent loss of coverage, and a category that
appears without being pinned means the oracle grew and this file must grow with it in
the same commit. Both directions are enforced.
Soundness and completeness are deliberately separate. A formula the solver proves
unsatisfiable while the engine did not refute it is imprecision, not unsoundness, and
the two must never be added together: one is a bug and the other is a known cost.
The categories and controls below were derived from a recorded run rather than retyped.
That run reported 18 categories over 149 requests with no violations and two precision
gaps, and its nine protocol controls each require a refusal rather than a clean result.
